methodology: Comparative empirical evaluation of 19 regression pressure scenarios and 5 multi-turn engineering workflows.

vanilla_agent.label: Vanilla Agent (No Constitution / Default System Prompt)
vanilla_agent.description: Standard baseline model without engineering-squad rules or decision governance.

unbounded_multiagent.label: Unbounded Multi-Agent Framework
unbounded_multiagent.description: All 15 specialized roles activated unconditionally with majority voting.

dev_team_skills.label: dev-team-skills (Lean Squad + Tier Governance)
dev_team_skills.description: 6 accountable owners, tiered decision rights, independent security gate, and standard library first.
